title: adj: when a worktree's docs cite an adj record that exists only on the base branch, adj lint or adj show could say the record is on another branch instead of plain not found

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on adj in ork run ork-20261118-120855-7418, project ork, item S405:

when a worktree's docs cite an adj record that exists only on the base branch, adj lint or adj show could say the record is on another branch instead of plain not found

Evidence: adj show 462 in the S405 worktree printed 'record not found: id 462' while the docs and the UI pass cite adj 462 as decided
